parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of domain names to return on each page. Valid values: an integer from **1** to **500**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: QueryArgs
parameters.description: The query conditions. You can filter domain names by name. Fuzzy match is supported `QueryArgs={"DomainName":"Accelerated domain name"}`
